responsibility: Implements the auxiliary feasible_graph used to search and visualize feasible path trees through the exploded graph. It materializes feasibility_state snapshots at each explored node, records infeasible edges with rejected constraints, reconstructs exploded_path instances from feasible nodes, and provides dot/text dumping and statistics that support shortest-feasible-path selection and debugging of path-feasibility reasoning.
same_name_distinction: Defines the out-of-line behavior of the feasible-graph types declared in feasible-graph.h, especially graph construction, infeasible-edge recording, exploded_path reconstruction, and dot/text/statistics dumping for feasible-path exploration.
